clos.original_description: Distinguish the major generative-AI model families and implement tokenization and PyTorch data pipelines.
clos.enriched_description: Distinguish the major generative-AI model families and implement tokenization and PyTorch data pipelines. The scope includes Specialization Introduction Generative AI and LLMs: Architecture and Data Preparation; Tokenization techniques with NLTK, spaCy, Hugging Face; and PyTorch data loaders and pipelines for generative AI.

clos.original_description: Build NLP systems using foundational language-modelling techniques
clos.enriched_description: Build NLP systems using foundational language-modelling techniques. The scope includes Gen AI Foundational Models for NLP & Language Understanding; Word embeddings: Word2Vec, GloVe; Document classification; Encoder-decoder RNNs; and Introduction to attention mechanisms.

clos.original_description: Apply transformer LLMs to generation, classification, translation, and understanding tasks.
clos.enriched_description: Apply transformer LLMs to generation, classification, translation, and understanding tasks. The scope includes Generative AI Language Modeling with Transformers; Transformer architecture in depth; and Applying transformers to translation, classification, and text generation.

clos.original_description: Adapt LLMs for domain tasks using PEFT, instruction tuning, and alignment
clos.enriched_description: Adapt LLMs for domain tasks using PEFT, instruction tuning, and alignment. The scope includes Generative AI Engineering and Fine-Tuning Transformers; Hugging Face fine-tuning pipelines; Parameter-efficient fine-tuning: LoRA, QLoRA, adapters; Quantization for fine-tuning on consumer GPUs; Generative AI Advance Fine-Tuning for LLMs; and Instruction tuning; reward modelling; preference data.

clos.original_description: Design, build, and deploy production LLM applications using RAG, vector stores, and agent patterns.
clos.enriched_description: Design, build, and deploy production LLM applications using RAG, vector stores, and agent patterns. The scope includes Fundamentals of AI Agents Using RAG and LangChain; LangChain components, chains, agents; and Embeddings, vector stores, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
